newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Aboitiz board approves buyback of shares.
newsitem.headline: Aboitiz board approves buyback of shares.

text.p: Aboitiz Equity Ventures Inc's board of directors has approved a buyback of shares which were undervalued, the company said on Monday.
In a statement, AEV said its management will decide the buyback price and the number of shares to be purchased. It did not give further details.
The buyback is expected to improve earnings per share, AEV added. The firm said it will set aside an amount from the company's unrestricted retained earnings for the buyback.
AEV said its businesses in electricity and financial services continued to show robust earnings and strong growth potential.
AEV shares closed two centavos lower on Monday at 1.86 pesos. The stock has dropped 43 percent from its peak this year of 3.25 pesos.
